title: build_part warns on encoding problem but caller never surfaces warning per-part
description: parse.rs build_part: if part.is_encoding_problem is true, a warning string is pushed to the global 'warnings: Vec<String>'. There is no per-part field for this flag, so callers cannot correlate a warning with the specific part struct. When a message has 3 parts and one has an encoding problem, the warnings list contains a string like 'part 1.2: encoding problem' but there is no structured way to query it. This creates a maintainer burden: any code that wants to act on per-part encoding issues must parse warning strings. Consider adding an is_encoding_problem: bool field to ParsedPart.
close_reason: Fixed: added is_encoding_problem: bool to ParsedPart in part.rs, populated from mail-parser's flag in build_part() in parse.rs. The warning string is kept for display purposes. The decode.rs test helper also updated. All 35 tests pass.
